content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have two locations, A and B. In location A, I plan to install a [product_name] from [company_name] and want to monitor its data from location B using a [product_name] operator panel. Since an Ethernet cable can't be used, I'm considering two WiFi access points for communication. Is this setup feasible?
This should work if both devices are on the same subnet.
Thank you, your reply was very helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing wireless monitoring solutions for a [product_name] system using a [product_name] operator device. The main challenge is enabling reliable remote monitoring when Ethernet cabling is not an option, demonstrating flexibility in network configuration but also highlighting user uncertainty about establishing wireless communication.
analysis.user_expectations: Users aim to achieve stable wireless communication between a [product_name] and a [product_name] operator device over WiFi, seeking consistent monitoring even when limited by network setup constraints.
